FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 464
Committee: Constitution, Campaigns and Sponsor: Representative Kenyatté Hassell
Elections
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/22/2023
House Bill 464 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Secretary of State and the
judges of probate by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to print updated absentee
ballot affidavits, as provided by this bill.
